title: Command catalogue
summary: One catalogue of runnable ids (commands, tools, options, actions) with words (group, description, when, params, risky) feeding the palette, the MCP command tools and ./formvis cli. Built in the window, mirrored by the engine, gated by counts --commands --check.
description: Frontend `catalogue.ts` builds entries from the live registry (commands, every tool and option, actions) and runs them (`runCommand`, `runCommands` as one history step); `command-meta.ts` holds the words, `metaFor(id, label)` returns them. `routers/commands.py` keeps the last mirror the window posts to `/api/commands/catalogue` and serves list, describe and run (run is forwarded to the window through the MCP bridge). `setup/cli.py` is the command line that uses these routes and `setup/line_counts.py --commands` is the size and word gate (minimum 620 ids). Imports the Commands registry in ../ui/commands (the palette slot, not seeded).
statusReason: seeded from B06 for the owner to confirm

exports.doc: One catalogue row: id, label, kind (command, tool, option or action), group, description, when-to-use, params, mutates and risky flags, keys.

exports.signature: export interface RunResult { ok: boolean; result?: unknown; error?: string }
exports.doc: Outcome of running an id: ok, result or error.
What the app hands the catalogue: engine, commands and the filter/adjustment/relight appliers.

exports.signature: export function listCommands(filter?: { group?: string; text?: string }): CatalogueEntry[]
exports.doc: Lists entries, optionally filtered by group or text.

exports.signature: export function describeCommand(id: string): CatalogueEntry | null
exports.doc: One entry by id, or null.

exports.signature: export function catalogueReport(): { size: number; missing: string[]; groups: Record<string, number> }
exports.doc: Size, ids lacking metadata and a count per group; the data behind counts --commands --check.

exports.signature: export async function runCommand(id: string, params: Record<string, unknown> = {}): Promise<RunResult>
exports.doc: Runs one id with params and returns a RunResult.

exports.signature: export async function runCommands(list: Array<{ id: string; params?: Record<string, unknown> }>, name = 'Run Commands'): Promise<{ ok: boolean; results: RunResult[]; error?: string }>
exports.doc: Runs ids in order; more than one is one history step; stops at the first failure and says which.
Stores the app deps and the command registry, then rebuilds and mirrors the catalogue to /api/commands/catalogue 600 ms after each registry change.
The facade object: listCommands, describeCommand, runCommand, runCommands, report.

exports.signature: export interface CommandMeta { group: string; description: string; when: string; params?: Record<string, CommandParam>; mutates?: boolean; risky?: boolean }
exports.doc: The words for a command: group, description, when to use, parameters, mutates and risky.

exports.signature: export function metaFor(id: string, label: string): CommandMeta | null
exports.doc: Metadata for an id (or null when none exists, which counts --commands --check reports).

invariants.text: The engine is reached on loopback only, behind the app-wide LocalGuard middleware (app/core/local_guard.py, not in this corpus); routes that act (start processes, write settings or secrets, WebSockets) also check the request origin with require_local or origin_ok.
Every command and tool has metadata (group, description, when); ./formvis counts --commands --check fails while one lacks it or the catalogue is under 620 ids.
Palette, MCP command tools and the CLI read this one catalogue; do not add a command to one surface only.
After adding or renaming commands, open the window once and run agents sync so the generated references follow.
